title: Product Manual for Safety of Toys According to IS 9873 (Part 1):2019
purpose: Guidelines for certification of Toys under Scheme I (ISI Mark).

operational_guidelines.sampling_guidelines: Samples drawn based on representative models covering intended age groups (under 36 months vs 36+ months).
operational_guidelines.scheme_of_inspection_and_testing: Routine quality tests must include small parts cylinder verification, sharp edge tester, sharp point tester, and impact drop test.
primary_test_equipment_required: Small parts test cylinder (inner diameter 31.7 mm, depth 25.4-57.1 mm)
Sharp edge tester with PTFE tape mandrel
Sharp point tester with 4.5 N spring indicator
Drop test mechanism with steel impact plate
